items.title: Fail leaderboard eligibility closed when the live simulation recovers from a score-affecting stage fault.
items.why: Live App.jsx inspection found the dynamic objective/wave transition stage catches every exception and silently continues, while submitScore remains online-eligible. A recovered run can therefore diverge from intended deterministic content without carrying any integrity receipt.
items.recipe: Add a pure bounded run-integrity ledger with stage, sanitized reason, wave and timestamp; record recovered objective/director faults; expose a compact HUD/death-screen LOCAL ONLY receipt only when degraded; short-circuit online submission while preserving local history and explicit feedback; test dedupe, bounds, clean eligibility, degraded eligibility and non-causality/no-fabrication language.

L2.recipe: Add a pure fault receipt, bounded dedupe and focused submission tests.

items.title: Replace independent top-center offsets with a deterministic combat-airspace stack.
items.why: HUD.jsx hard-codes active drill at top 30, speedrun and run modifier at top 28, challenge at 46, then derives ghost/rival offsets without accounting for those surfaces. Compound modes can render multiple cards on the same pixels, obscuring gameplay and assistive text.
items.recipe: Create a pure getHudCenterStackLayout contract that reserves ordered slots for drill, speedrun/modifier, challenge, ghost pack, weekly rival and rival pace; collapse mutually exclusive timer/modifier states intentionally; wire every surface to its slot; add desktop/mobile/compound-mode tests and accessible titles without changing game balance.

L1.recipe: Offset the known collisions with conditional arithmetic.

L2.recipe: Centralize ordered offsets in hudLayout and cover major combinations.

L3.recipe: Ship a deterministic responsive stack contract for every current top-center surface with compound-mode regression coverage.
